title: Accessibility is part of quality
summary: Accessibility means people with different needs can use the app. Test labels, keyboard access and visible focus as well as mouse clicks.
introduction: Accessibility means people with different needs can use the app. Test labels, keyboard access and visible focus as well as mouse clicks. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain accessibility is part of quality
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Accessibility means people with different needs can use the app. Test labels, keyboard access and visible focus as well as mouse clicks.

blocks.code:
Input label: Search lessons
Keyboard: Tab reaches input; Enter submits
Focus: a visible border marks the active control
blocks.title: Accessibility is part of quality

blocks.text: A learner can understand and operate the search without a mouse. Automatic checks help, but people still need to review it.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Check a form using only Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A color change alone may not explain an error to every learner.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
